text:
Situation: Penicillin G potassium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-04-26 and remains current as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 42 months. Corvale East holds two lots totaling 528 units providing 18 days of supply at current usage. Corvale General holds two lots totaling 571.81 units providing 18 days of supply at current usage.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the penicillin G benzathine injection shortage on 2023-04-26. FDA inspection 1208260 at the Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC plant (FEI 1810189) ended 2023-06-16 with a VAI classification; the classification letter was issued 2024-09-10, 51 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 18 days at both sites. The rule-selected alternate manufacturer is A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place. Pfizer's estimated recovery is 4Q 2027 per FDA updates.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies availability and sourcing for A-S Medication Solutions; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer evaluates Athenex Pharmaceutical Division, LLC as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer evaluates Avenacy Inc. as tertiary source; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer monitors FDA updates for Pfizer recovery timeline; requires pharmacy director approval.
5. Buyer reports supply status weekly to pharmacy director; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Switching to any alternate manufacturer without verified availability and P&T committee review.
